results.source_quote: Eligibility is based on the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 database using deprivation criteria D1 to D7 for rural areas and 11 occupational categories for urban areas.
Income ceilings vary by category and state: SC/ST typically up to Rs 2.5 lakh per annum, OBC/EBC up to Rs 1-2.5 lakh (state-specific), Minorities up to Rs 2 lakh.
Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India
Eligibility: Landholding farmer family with cultivable land; Excludes income tax payers
